name: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd
title: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd - 543985 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Zaggle Q2 FY27 is a services-and-fintech read with no capacity signal; consolidated revenue up 34%, adj. EBITDA margin ~7.7%, OCF turned positive, but FY27 EBITDA guided only ~7-8% and program-fee growth slowed to 12.5% YoY.

summary.headline: Zaggle Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue up 34% with adjusted EBITDA margin about 7.7%, and operating cash flow turned positive on both standalone and consolidated basis.
summary.overview: Management reported 34% total revenue growth, with H1 revenue crossing INR1,000 crores for the first time, helped by festive-season loyalty demand and the Dice SaaS contribution. Consolidated adjusted EBITDA margin was about 7.7%, with Dice payroll for 100+ AI professionals absorbed while only 65-70% of Dice contracts have novated. Positive operating cash flow, on both standalone and consolidated basis, was the headline achievement, attributed to banking terms, half-monthly invoicing and customer advances. Management guided EBITDA margin to a similar 7-8% range and said Save/Zoyer tax-driven loads grew sharply (about 6x), though program fee growth YoY was only about 12.5%.

financial_highlights.value: Crossed INR1,000 crores (first time in H1)

financial_highlights.change: Program fee YoY growth about 12.5%; QoQ about 22%
Normalised from Q1 FY27 which had overriding commission spillover
Marginal improvement QoQ; from about 69% in Q4 FY26

segments.name: Zaggle core / SaaS and Dice
segments.commentary: Dice revenue sits entirely in SaaS; about 65-70% of contracts novated, rest expected in Q3. Dice steady revenue last year was about INR14 crores, and novation carries a lag before revenue starts.

segments.name: Propel / Save / Zoyer (program fees)
segments.commentary: Save loads grew about 6x with meal and gift allowance limits up roughly 4x and 3x; Zoyer rolled out to more than 5,500 stores at one retail chain versus 2,000 previously cited.

segments.name: GreenEdge (subsidiary)
segments.commentary: Revenue about INR58 crores, EBITDA about INR2.6 crores, PAT about the same; EBITDA declined sequentially as security investment rises for NPCI redemptions.

segments.name: 86400 (formerly Mobileware)
segments.commentary: Revenue about INR22.4 crores, EBITDA about INR6 crores, PAT about INR3 crores in Q2; H1 transaction value about INR3 lakh crores, up 26% YoY. Q1 EBITDA included one-time items.

segments.name: TaxSpanner
segments.commentary: H1 FY27 revenue about INR2.1 crores, up about 22.6% YoY on a half-year basis; EBITDA breakeven achieved in H1, full-year breakeven targeted.

segments.name: Zagg.money
segments.commentary: User and transaction count surged; about 3 million UPI transactions a month. Some EBITDA burn expected over the next few quarters.

guidance_outlook: EBITDA margin expected in a similar range to current levels, around 7-8%, though lower than last year; management declined to guide firmly on full-year EBITDA.
Operating cash flow positivity remains a key focus; management wants to control capitalisation.
Dice revenue expected to build fully in Q3 and Q4 as remaining 30-35% of contracts novate, plus cross-sell and upsell.
Zagg.money expected to burn some EBITDA over the next few quarters while scaling users.
Program fee growth expected to see momentum between Q2 and Q3 FY27.
Investor Day planned on 10 December 2026 in Mumbai.
UPI MDR implementation expected after Diwali, subject to government; quantum not yet known and not quantified by management.
capex_capacity: Zaggle Holdings Limited opened in ADGM, Abu Dhabi, as international subsidiary.
Full-stack Agentic AI accounts payable platform went live in phase one at a large manufacturing, metals and minerals client, ahead of schedule; targets about 60% touchless invoice processing.
AI-driven initiatives reportedly delivered 10-15% gain in people cost efficiency and about 50% reduction in time to launch new product modules.
Accelerating shift to modular microservices architecture.
Management is controlling capitalisation of tech and AI costs; some tech and AI costs now pushed directly into P&L, raising other expenses.
demand_pricing: Around 4 million users on Zaggle cards and software; more than 4,200 corporate customers.
Save: new marquee wins include R Systems, Kerala Fibre Optic Network, Vivo Mobiles, SBM Bank, RPG Enterprises; Cleartrip and Birla Opus contracts novated.
Zoyer: wins include FirstRand Bank, Netmeds, P N Gadgil Jewellers, Bandhan AMC; inherited Hindalco, Bajel Projects, Navi from Dice.
Propel: DCM Shriram and Hero Cycles signed; Q2 cross-sell wins include Techno Sportswear, Centrient Pharma, Smartworks, Aditya Auto.
Management says festive season drove strong redemption growth; Propel Points margin normalised to about 5.3%.

qa_highlights.question: How should FY27 EBITDA guidance be viewed now that Dice integration is complete?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said EBITDA margins are lower than last year but expected in a similar range of about 7-8%, with focus on positive OCF and controlled capitalisation.

qa_highlights.question: Are Save tax-regime loads flowing through, given muted program fee growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Loads grew about 6x; balances sit on cards so spends come later. Meal allowance rose about 4x and gift about 3x under both tax regimes.

qa_highlights.question: How much of Q2 revenue is from Dice and what is its run rate?
qa_highlights.answer: Dice revenue is entirely SaaS; only a small part of about INR16 crores SaaS fees in Q2. Last year's steady Dice revenue was about INR14 crores; full impact expected in Q3 and Q4.

qa_highlights.question: What is the impact of tiered UPI MDR on Zaggle and Zagg.money?
qa_highlights.answer: Management sees it as positive given over 3 million Zagg.money transactions a month; implementation expected after Diwali, but quantum not quantifiable yet.

qa_highlights.question: Why is full-year EBITDA guided flattish despite the 6x Save loads?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said higher loads will lift program fee revenue but declined to guide EBITDA, citing caution and multiple cost layers.

qa_highlights.question: Why did GreenEdge and Mobileware EBITDA fall sequentially?
qa_highlights.answer: Mobileware Q1 included one-time events; GreenEdge margins do not rise in step with revenue because of security investment for UPI switch and NPCI redemptions.

qa_highlights.question: When will program fee growth return to 20-30%?
qa_highlights.answer: Program fee grew about 22% QoQ but 12.5% YoY; management sees momentum building between Q2 and Q3 with cashback held near 66%.

risks_watch: Dice novation: 30-35% of contracts still pending, with lag before revenue; EBITDA depends on this ramp.
Zagg.money burn over next few quarters as user base scales.
Program fee YoY growth only about 12.5%, below the 20-30% range investors had sought.
UPI MDR timing and quantum set by government, not yet quantifiable.
Prepaid card loading balances (INR264 crores at year-end per analyst) sit in other assets; management says they have come down slightly.
Management declined to firmly guide full-year EBITDA; cost of AI and tech moved into P&L.
summary.management_tone: Confident on top-line momentum, cash flow turnaround and AI deployments, but cautious on EBITDA guidance and repeatedly described early OCF wins as early and a long way to go. Evasive on quantifying UPI MDR upside and on the exact program fee growth recovery timeline.
key_quotes: On the operating cash flow, I am very happy to announce that we have achieved a positive operating cash flow, not only at a standalone basis, but also at a consolidated basis for Q2 FY27.
We are keeping our feet on the ground as these are early wins, and we have a long distance to travel.
We want to be very calibrated in how we look at our cash flows and our capitalization.
We see this to be a very significant move for Zaggle and Zagg Money especially, which is a TPAP.

adds.what: Full-stack Agentic AI accounts payable platform (software, phase one live at a large manufacturing client)
Zoyer rollout to more than 5,500 stores at one retail chain (distribution reach, not owned capacity)

growth.why: Management guided only EBITDA margin of about 7-8% for FY27 (no revenue growth guidance; Q2 consolidated revenue up 34%), with growth backed by Dice novation (65-70% done, rest in Q3), festive loyalty demand and program-fee momentum, but no firm capacity additions were quantified.

oneOffs.what: Dice SaaS contribution is part of the headline 34% growth; Dice steady revenue last year was about INR14 cr, and only 65-70% of contracts novated so the ramp is still pending

quality.why: Growth is driven by higher program-fee volumes (Save/Zoyer loads up about 6x, Propel redemptions), but YoY program-fee growth is only about 12.5%, and the Dice SaaS piece is an acquisition-related addition still ramping, so the headline 34% is not fully recurring-business growth.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Management guided EBITDA margin to a similar 7-8% range, lower than last year, with Dice payroll absorbed before only 65-70% of contracts novated and AI/tech costs moved into P&L.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: No owned capacity (plants, lines) was quantified; Zoyer reach expanded to 5,500+ stores and the Zaggle Holdings ADGM subsidiary opened, but these are distribution and corporate steps, not capacity additions.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Program fees grew about 22% QoQ and 12.5% YoY with momentum expected between Q2 and Q3, Save loads up about 6x, and Dice revenue to build fully in Q3-Q4 as the remaining 30-35% of contracts novate.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Capex was not discussed; management said it is controlling capitalisation of tech and AI costs.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management declined to firmly guide full-year EBITDA and guided margin flat at about 7-8%, with cost layers and Zagg.money burn ahead.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Full-year EBITDA guidance is soft, Dice novation is 65-70% done, and Zagg.money will burn EBITDA while scaling; program fee YoY growth of 12.5% is below the 20-30% investors sought.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Agentic AI accounts payable platform went live in phase one (about 60% touchless invoice target) and management is accelerating a modular microservices architecture, with new modules launching about 50% faster.

rows.label: Dice novation and Q3-Q4 revenue build
rows.why: About 65-70% of Dice contracts novated with the rest expected in Q3; Dice steady revenue last year was about INR14 crores, so the ramp adds to SaaS fees of about INR16 crores in Q2.

rows.label: UPI MDR tiered implementation
rows.why: Management sees it as positive on over 3 million Zagg.money transactions a month, but timing depends on government and quantum is not quantified.

rows.label: Positive operating cash flow sustained
rows.why: OCF turned positive standalone and consolidated on banking terms, half-monthly invoicing and customer advances, though management called it early with a long way to go and prepaid loading balances (INR264 crores per analyst) are declining slightly.

tone.note: Management was confident on top-line momentum, the OCF turnaround and AI deployments, but cautious on EBITDA guidance and on UPI MDR quantum; analysts pressed on program fee growth (12.5% YoY vs the 20-30% sought) and on why full-year EBITDA was guided flat despite the 6x Save loads.
